name: Ner (brother of Kish, father of Abner)
title: Abner's father and royal relative
summary: Ner was the father of Abner, who became commander-in-chief for King Saul. He was the brother of Kish and thus the uncle of King Saul. Through his son Abner, his family played an important role in Israel's early monarchy.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Abner's father
keyEvents.description: Ner is identified as the father of Abner, Saul's commander-in-chief, in connection with the introduction of Saul's family.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Ner is mentioned in the genealogy of Benjamin and Saul's family, confirming his place in the royal line.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the genealogy
keyEvents.description: Ner's lineage is confirmed again in the genealogical overview of Saul's ancestors in Chronicles.
